decisions.reason: The decorative carpet still has its own page and fits the core rug offer, and the firm has publicly backed it, so management will give it more time rather than admit an early misjudgement.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet carries sunk sourcing and craftsmanship investment and embodies the firm's fine-materials positioning, which strongly favours persistence.
As a collection piece close to the core offer, any weak results can still be put down to the long sales cycles of premium rugs, so keeping it remains justifiable.
The corner bench extends the furniture range into residential and hospitality projects, and its development investment and visible presentation favour continuing.
The low-pile carpet costs little to keep in the portfolio and is publicly listed, so dropping it offers little gain against the commitment already made.
The multi-model swivel shell chair line represents major tooling and design commitment that is central to the firm's direction, so management will persist with it.
